goal: Estimate incremental expected value of casting a specific spell versus skipping at same legally reached decision, for balance review rather than displaying perfect probabilities to players.

sampling.match_randomness: common random numbers from cloned complete game state, separately seeded subsequent decision policy, identical starting state and private deck; do not expose counterfactual cards to an actual in-game agent

arm_a: cast chosen legal spell, follow fixed downstream policy, resolve hand and if feasible the rest of table
arm_b: skip spell in same window, follow same downstream policy
report: n per category and by street/stack depth
paired mean EV difference and bootstrap 95% CI
number of paired replays with different legal trees
flag analyses with incompatible state continuations
requirements: P0-P6 chip and RNG invariants in every branch
counterfactual always offline for analysis, not an on-screen odds oracle
difference in downstream outcomes is allowed; never force identical actions when illegal
preserve private-info boundaries of acting agents
